items.title: Dr Rajendra Pd. DR.Anugrah Narayan Sinha
items.description: Dr Rajendra Prasad with his close colleague & nationalist Bihar Vibhuti Dr. Anugrah Narain Sinha taken during 1917 Gandhian Sataygraha at Bihar. This picture was taken in 1917 when Prasad & Sinha accompanied Mahatama Gandhi in Champaran and became incharge there. Historic Picture of the eminent public figures taken during 1917 MK Gandhi's famous Satyagraha movement of 1917 in Bihar.
items.author: Anugrah Abhinandan Granth (1946)
